# Viraj Domadia

> Frontend-heavy full-stack developer in Bengaluru, India. Open to full-time and freelance work, on-site in Bengaluru or remote.

## About

Viraj Domadia is a frontend-heavy full-stack developer based in Bengaluru, originally from Mumbai. He works with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. He builds the client, the server and the data layer as one product, and has four full-stack products live, from Tripsmith to Platter. He is completing an online MCA at Amity University (2025–2027) and is open to full-time and freelance work, on-site in Bengaluru or remote.

## Experience

- Software Engineer · Zapigo (2025-10 → present): Own the frontend of zapigo.com: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, TanStack Query, Zustand and React Aria, with Vitest + Playwright tests and Sentry monitoring. Built Personal Invites end to end — create and share a digital invitation in under 30 seconds — including its FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend.
- IT Executive · Venus Vacations Pvt. Ltd (2024-07 → 2025-11): Ran the company’s IT and hardware. Alongside that, built the company website with a custom booking engine end to end — React front, Node/Express API, MongoDB — taken through internal review, not deployed.
- Application Development Associate · Accenture (2022-12 → 2023-07): Backup and support engineer on an enterprise client account: monitored NetBackup jobs, handled incidents and restores, and worked to SLAs in a large operations team.

## Education

- Master of Computer Applications (online), Amity University, 2025–2027
- B.Sc. Information Technology, Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics, Mumbai University, 2019–2022 (8.33 CGPA)

## Projects

- **Tripsmith** (Travel + AI trip planner; v3 live · complete — ai trip planner + bookings): A travel agency’s booking site with an AI trip planner that only quotes the real catalogue — live seats, deposits, Razorpay (test mode), GST invoices, refunds and an owner desk that reads every chat. Live: https://tripsmith.virajdomadia.com · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/tripsmith
- **Frontrow** (Live seat-map ticketing; live): Movie and concert tickets on a live seat map: tap a seat and it is held for ten minutes and greys out for everyone else — Redis holds, transactions, idempotent payments, QR tickets. Live: https://frontrow.virajdomadia.com · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/frontrow
- **Pagecraft** (Co-edited website builder; live): A landing-page editor two people use at the same time — live cursors, conflict-free merges, version history — then one click publishes it to its own subdomain. Live: https://pagecraft.virajdomadia.com · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/pagecraft
- **Platter** (Food delivery + live tracking; live): Customer, restaurant and rider apps on one order state machine — restaurants within a radius, live rider location on the customer’s map, role-checked transitions. Live: https://platter.virajdomadia.com · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/platter

Every project has a live URL and a public repo — open one, then read the code.

## Free tool and guides for small businesses

- [Free website check](https://virajdomadia.com/tools/website-checkup): paste a business website and get a plain-language report (Google visibility, phone-friendliness, tap-to-call and WhatsApp, trust) with the top 3 fixes. Free, no sign-up.
- [How to add a WhatsApp button to your business website](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/whatsapp-button-for-business-website): Step-by-step: create a click-to-chat WhatsApp link with a pre-filled message, put it where customers will tap it, and avoid the mistakes that cost enquiries. Works on WordPress, Wix, Shopify or any site.
- [Why your business isn’t showing up on Google (and how to fix it)](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/why-business-not-showing-on-google): The 7 most common reasons a small business doesn’t appear in Google search or Maps, how to check each one yourself in minutes, and what to do about it. No jargon.
- [How to make your phone number clickable on your website (tap-to-call)](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/make-phone-number-clickable-on-website): Turn the phone number on your website into a one-tap call button on mobile. The exact link format for Indian numbers, plus how to do it on WordPress, Wix, Shopify and plain HTML.
- [WhatsApp link preview not showing an image? Here’s how to fix it](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/whatsapp-link-preview-not-showing-image): Why your website shows as a plain link with no photo when shared on WhatsApp, and how to fix it with Open Graph tags, the right image size, and clearing WhatsApp’s preview cache.
- [Why your website says “Not secure”, and how to fix it](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/website-not-secure-warning-fix): What the “Not secure” warning in Chrome means, why it scares off customers, and how to fix it with a free SSL certificate on common Indian hosting, WordPress, and other website builders.
- [How to add Google Maps and a “Get directions” button to your website](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/add-google-maps-to-website): Two ways to show your location: embed a Google Map, and add a one-tap “Get directions” button that opens navigation on the customer’s phone. Step by step, free, no API key.
- [How to make your business website load faster on mobile](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/make-website-faster-on-mobile): A plain-language checklist to speed up a slow small-business website on phones: compressing photos, removing heavy plugins and widgets, caching and hosting. With the free tools to measure it.
- [How to get more Google reviews for your business (the right way)](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/get-more-google-reviews-for-business): A simple system to get more genuine Google reviews: your direct review link, when and how to ask on WhatsApp, a message template, replying to reviews, and what not to do so you don’t break Google’s rules.
- [How much does a website cost for a small business in India? (2026)](https://virajdomadia.com/guides/website-cost-small-business-india): An honest breakdown of what a small-business website costs in India in 2026: DIY builders vs freelancers vs agencies, yearly running costs, hidden costs, and how to avoid overpaying.
